newsitem.title: USA: NY state budget chief says 1997 budget is on track.
newsitem.headline: NY state budget chief says 1997 budget is on track.

text.p: The New York State budget director said that the budget for 1997 remained on track through the first eight months of the state's fiscal year.

"The operating results and projections through November are consistent with the mid-year financial plan update, and continue to show that the budget remains in balance for the 1996-1997 fiscal year," said Patricia Woodworth, in a prepared statement that was released late on Friday.
The Pataki Administration is expected to submit its budget for fiscal 1998 in January.
